unit_outage_maxgen_events.basis: data/raw/maxgen-events/ contains only ['miso'] plus a README. The registry is a HAND-CURATED per-ISO set of publicly declared capacity-emergency instruments, built for the MISO price-formation lane (M-1); no CAISO registry has ever been curated. CAISO does declare real analogues (EEA levels), so this is a data-intake gap rather than a structural n/a — the gate cannot be armed because there is no file, not because a detector proved it inert.
unit_outage_maxgen_events.disposition: REPORTED, NOT ARMED (PRECHECK §5 binding clause). Landing a CAISO registry is a separate data-intake charter with its own pre-registration, D-4 window and matrix cell.
